description: Fetch Snapcode images for one or more Snapchat usernames, read public profile metadata, or do both in a single run.

downloadToStorage.description: Save each fetched Snapcode image to Apify key-value store and add a persistent URL to the record. Only applies to modes that fetch images.
downloadToStorage.title: Save images to key-value store

format.description: Snapcode image format (used in mode=snapcode and mode=full).
format.title: Image format

imageSize.description: Square image size in pixels (used in mode=snapcode and mode=full), from 32 to 1000. Values above 1000 are capped by Snapchat.
imageSize.title: Image size (pixels)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to save from this run.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: Snapcode image only, public profile metadata only, or both.
mode.title: What to collect

usernames.description: Snapchat usernames, @handles, or profile links. Examples: brentrivera, @brentrivera, https://www.snapchat.com/add/brentrivera, https://www.snapchat.com/@brentrivera.
usernames.title: Usernames or profile links

title: Snapchat Snapcode & Public Profile Scraper
